name: Bull Will Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1993 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, Bull Will Co., Ltd. operates as a manufacturer, distributor, and agent for an extensive range of electronic components. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses various transformers, including switching power, switching power-LED drivers, and LLC resonant types, alongside light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Bull Will also specializes in a wide selection of power inductors, offered in configurations such as SMD, DIP, molded, high-current flat, high-current bead, toroid, DR, and assembly types. For electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) solutions, they provide lead wire ferrite beads, AC line filters, SMD chip inductors, beads, filters, and common mode chokes. Further offerings include power hybrid devices, reactors, and SMD varistors. The firm additionally excels in producing customized and high-reliability magnetic components, such as ferrite cores, alloy powder cores, and amorphous powder cores, as well as critical parts like touch switches, connectors, and MOSFETs. These essential components are vital for a broad spectrum of applications and industries, including power supply units, LCD monitors, smartphones, laptops, server infrastructure, air conditioning systems, the automotive sector, and solar inverters.
